Here is the recap for your 14-day back-to-school demo campaign (**Friday, 6 August – Thursday, 19 August 2027, Dublin time**):

### Headline Numbers
* **Total Spend:** **$348.18 USD** (out of $350.00 USD budget — 99.5% utilization)
* **Impressions:** **327,029**
* **Link Clicks (to `nettlerow.ie/demo`):** **196** (average **$1.78 USD** per link click)

| Period | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Week 1** (6 Aug – 12 Aug) | $173.04 | 185,707 | 89 | $1.94 |
| **Week 2** (13 Aug – 19 Aug) | $175.14 | 141,322 | 107 | $1.64 |
| **Total (14 Days)** | **$348.18** | **327,029** | **196** | **$1.78** |

### What Worked & Key Optimizations
* **Winning Creative:** Post `2215779606328605826` (*"Two weeks until the school-run queue hits your counter..."*) drove the highest link click-through rate from Day 1 (`0.08%–0.15%` LCTR vs. `~0.01%–0.02%` on the other two posts). Shifting budget into single-post ad groups behind this creative lifted weekly link clicks by **+20%** in Week 2 while cutting cost per click from **$1.94** to **$1.64**.
* **Audience & Geography (IE & UK Only):** All ad groups were strictly geo-fenced to **Ireland** and the **United Kingdom** (`AGE_OVER_25`, `DEFINED` audience targeting with no expansion). B2B pharmacy keyword targeting (`pharmacy`, `pharmacist`, `independent pharmacy`, `community pharmacy`, `dispensary`, `dispensary manager`, `superintendent pharmacist`, `pharmacy owner`, `locum pharmacist`, `pharmacy stock`, `wholesaler`, `chemist`, `retail pharmacy`) outperformed general business interests and follower lookalikes, which were paused early so budget stayed concentrated on high-intent pharmacy traffic.
* **Status:** The campaign (`z6xpu`) and all ad groups are now completed and paused.
